facts.fact: Technical trials of Level 3 biometric digital identity had begun with the Central Bank of Libya and a number of banks, ahead of launch and integration, per the General Information Authority.
facts.system: Digital Identity Management System for Citizens

facts.fact: The Digital Identity Management System for Citizens has a Level 3 identity based on biometric data, described as the highest level of digital verification.
